Oe434cd59d06182d1a8a3.source: With our highly attuned senses and powers, we were able to find solutions that

Oc85892a707445187e050.source: benefitted all of society at once.

Oa7df5019caa76119d935.source: would throw the very planet itself into chaos...

O2b0ac043813d13a5a929.source: Gifted beyond her years, with an uncanny ability to find solutions others missed

O616a36324a06d6d7df58.source: the ESPer Traeh seemed like a fine addition to the council.

Of6d39cdca438765df91f.source: She was readily granted access to the stores of power that we Fenfen kept.

O5c8518ab41be9fde168d.source: Power... that she then proceeded to corrupt.

O8c685173ad8781a61d0f.source: Traeh was left deeply disfigured, down to her very core.

Oc6df3a1ef2b826e167cc.source: Maybe if we, the remaining elder ESPers of the council, reacted faster

Oe3723f8592b193d80bd1.source: then we could've prevented the calamity that was about to befall our people.

Ofc8881c2290b7de859db.source: Alas, we did not, and that will forever be our greatest failing...

O7000537df64cbba0bf78.source: Free my brothers and sisters and restore peace to the land!

O64c282165c424cfd7ad6.source: When Traeh turned her aggressions to us remaining members of the ESPer council

Oe4e2546be316c1fb2a9e.source: Those years at the academy really paid off, and I took the loads to prove it!

O674d7a2414d127ef5c79.source: They seemed to be waiting for some kind of show to start...

O72417861043e18750974.source: ...but what was the show? This could be some important data to collect!

Oe3be8de3ee76625d2ad3.source: Well, a cold nose under my tail helped clue me in to what the show was gonna be.

O9ef6fd1d15a04d1b8d92.source: The shock of all this hap- pening while I was under a blindingly bright spotlight

O96023262139074ec9816.source: snapped me out of my Kobold pleasure fascination real quick!!

Obcdf85bebe908e4189bf.source: After taking note of the Barker's giant canid phallus and the copius ejaculations

Oced02a1fb297d044adbf.source: I looked around to see what I was /really/ taking part of.

O075c27a074b7299e9aee.source: ...and it was an auction! They were auctioning off... me?!?

O138a1976323df826a569.source: That was all I had time to process before the Barker shoved that huge knot inside

O69dcbca7f2803bca0373.source: causing me to freeze up ag- ain while I tried to process just how... huge! It! Was!

Od6dd3f30f23977bd9da2.source: I could barely keep my mind straight as the Barker dragged me along the stage

O4ab5e59eae971ae338f6.source: showing off my raised tail to all the alien auction goers.

Od7ed49e6b50d21537b66.source: Pretty sure I heard the sounds of bidding before I blacked out once more...

Oa307950de5f57ff96f25.source: So, yeah. Kobolds love me! Or at least, they /loved/ me.

Occ5d261f129e94bbab5c.source: I can tell you all sorts of sexy tidbits about them, just try me!

O575d7a58016694fc7108.source: Ouch! That last blow really ruffled my fluff!

Od56dfa1666915dc69b95.source: But everyone's counting on me, so I gotta get back up and keep fighting!

O501d4b8fe69fa8291b36.source: Nnhg... just... need a moment... to lay here and catch my breath...

O2e564fbc64811b075cee.source: Hopefully the data recorders got all this. I seem to have been 'acquired' by

O4587273ee63fe5dce2da.source: one of the two bipedal species native to this area, the Gobins.

O657f7d4c5534c5cea79d.source: As the big male carried me into the woods, I was still too dazed to put up a fight.

Ob5d4748fbf27e98de3c4.source: I tried to tell him that I was on a really important mission, but either

O09997d6d67b147e187a1.source: he didn't speak galactic... or he just didn't care...

Ofaf9cc35b342640e9b0b.source: Once he got me back to the Gobin village, I was in for a really rude welcome!

O66237c1649708640f8a9.source: They immediately took turns passing me around and breeding me on the spot!!

Ode8d3bf758594d19c0ef.source: They were so big, and they just used me like I was a toy.

O9f421f1f2ed272b338a3.source: Just jamming their hot Gobin cocks all the way up into my tummy, again and again!

O2c807d38f2abb436191e.source: It was... Ugh... Rough... tiring... But kinda nice, at first...

O15da30ca6d6fa71a4680.source: The others pawwed through my equipment, jabbering about it and sorting it.

Oc5cef692f89b744afd4c.source: I didn't see any of that gear again. I think they sold it to space pirates...

O819ca4b22e772dbe269e.source: Once they had their fill, they put me in a hanging cage at edge of the village.

O7e537ac99d2a34232244.source: After that? I'm not sure how long they kept me... A week? Two...?

O2f66acd963fa472f32f2.source: I don't think I ever got more than an hour of rest between rough breedings.

Oae9116f31e7aefc7081b.source: The morning patrols... the afternoon patrols... I was free use for everyone!

O8312797373f8140f131a.source: collected by me... ah...! painstakingly...! inch by... ugh... *thick* inch!

O2888cb259c546099b8f3.source: Look, I'm a bottom agent right? I knew what I was signing up for...

O0b06d414809698a785b9.source: ...but jeez, even I've got my limits! This was all too much!

Obb6bcc14dac49c0a2cea.source: I wanted to escape, but all those Gobin cocks really took the fight out of me...

O5c32e2dd9cf9735c6b7b.source: ...and they kept a real close eye on me in my cage, too.

O6d7c7bafc13760bb6bc4.source: Even the slightest untoward movement was an invitation for another rough pounding!

O11a891b1d54bea0feb65.source: So... as much as I'd like to say that I executed a brilliant escape plan...

Oeafda9bcf4dd205cd063.source: ...it was really just dumb luck, the way it happened.

Ob7ced5ed9907a17f2087.source: Somehow, I scrambled down the nearest tree. My legs were shaking.

O543cae7561182325374b.source: My only hope was to somehow make my way back to the hangar and regroup.

Oe7e0a7c0eb634e305356.source: ...but I didn't make it far before I was intercepted. Not by Gobins, thankfully.

Obbcd3e1af72df9343b0e.source: It was a tall Elf lady. Someone who could speak my language, at least.

O4f350f3e057c902e3e56.source: 'There there little one, just relax...' and so on.

Odc2421d59e6126a83f5c.source: After my rough and messy Gobin captivity, this was all so relaxing...

O08521470667c58262605.source: ...I guess I just kinda... melted... and let the elves do... hmmf...

O155945b62d841ce781fe.source: My head swam. I felt... intoxicated...?

Oc99014a2ddfac9b6bc2d.source: 'Shush, little one. Open your legs... lift your tail...'

O1f21e9033dba425be7fd.source: [LOOKS LIKE OUR PUP JUST GOT HIMSELF AN ENERGY BUCKLER.]

O3a2c187cc1d74f910f6b.source: [THAT'S NOT PART OF STANDARD AGENT GEAR. KNOW HOW TO USE IT?]

Oedf4b100d9b153a42153.source: [I THINK SO! I TOOK A CLASS ON ADVANCED COMBAT GEAR.]

Ofcad33f16d79f0fb7ca6.source: [TO ACTIVATE THE BUCKLER, I JUST CROUCH, RIGHT?]

O149358b15fa07a407220.source: [THAT'S RIGHT! ANY SMALL PROJ- ECTILES WILL BE REPELLED.]

O959757afcb17368f2126.source: [YOU'LL HAVE TO LOWER THE BUCKLER TO ATTACK, HOWEVER.]

O4b6a4374e037fc658e57.source: [IT SEEMS THAT NECKLACE YOU JUST... ACQUIRED WILL ALLOW]

Obd46222ef785f36f4aba.source: [YOU TO UNDERSTAND THE FENFEN LANGUAGE. YOU MIGHT WANNA]

O3bf6c937b9a138115f52.source: [REVIEW ANY FENFEN ACCOUNTS YOU'VE ALREADY LOGGED.]

O3c6870119aef4e747d3d.source: [AND YOU CAN SWING ACROSS ANY GAP WITH EASE.]

O0b74241b6ddf3f8c2785.source: [AS LONG AS I CAN GET GOOD PURCHASE, RIGHT?]

Oab8c2fccd3806da09789.source: [THAT FLASHLIGHT - OR TORCH, AS BOSSU CALLS IT - WILL]

Oa499d2700813b9a33720.source: [I DON'T HAVE TO DO ANYTHING SPECIAL TO USE IT, RIGHT?]

O03952464ee3257975bd9.source: [THAAT'S RIGHT, JUST LEAVE IT ON AND LET IT WORK ITS MAGIC!]

O528d05bb27e3d8a7cde6.source: [THAT'S *NOT* A STANDARD RADIO YOU'RE USING, PUP!]

Of480753fea0ef59f7a4a.source: [OH, IS THERE A PROBLEM WITH IT?]

O7ce2cbf07a0deba0c359.source: [NO THE SIGNAL IS FINE AND ALL. AND IT LOOKS LIKE IT HAS]

O9e9d44b9ce47621460f2.source: [ADVANCED SENSORS INSTALLED THAT WILL HELP YOUR MISSION!]

Obaad8ce29a775689b202.source: [HEY TOMCAT, SCAN THIS CRYSTAL THE BREEDER GAVE ME?]

O46790f1cf7e4b97a477d.source: [LOOKS LIKE IT'S A JAKOV'S OBSCURA CRYSTAL.]

Ob2dee70046f920c2187b.source: [TECHNICALLY, A FIELD ATTENUATED PRISM. IF YOU'VE]

O7a3b0a3815bee2c18206.source: [GOT A CREATURE WHO LIKES YOU A LOT, YOU CAN PET THEM TO]

Ob1e45ad533e25244da08.source: [CHARGE UP YOUR CRYSTAL WITH POWER! THE EFFECT IT HAS]

O31a2a0c30f19d03ef776.source: [WOW, SO IF I GET LOTS OF CREATURES TO LIKE ME, I CAN TRY]

Oc7b903c046595a6b2416.source: [SO THESE "ESPER" POWERS THAT OTHER AGENTS HAD...]

Ob0a366ecee3d12369186.source: [THE REPORTS WE RECEIVED SAID THAT, WHILE IN COMBAT]

O2fdfa2debe231616b249.source: [THE AGENTS COULD CHOOSE THEIR POWER WITH "SELECT"]

O56108ef44214a8d2e395.source: [AND THEN THEY COULD CALL FORTH THEIR ABILITIES]

Od5c45017e2d3716fab2f.source: [ALRIGHT, I'LL GIVE IT A SHOT. THANKS!]

O2fb0254b6c406892b8c2.source: [I GUESS THIS MEANS YOU JUST GRABBED ANOTHER OF THOSE]

Odf83e6a94af0175027fa.source: [ORBS WE CAN'T DETECT FROM HQ, HUH...]

O0949fb367f399cc98fb2.source: [ARE THERE ANY REPORTS OF OTHER POWERS?]

O6173e4e290a4182c8a90.source: [ASIDE FROM WHAT YOU'VE REPORTED SO FAR? WELL...]

O7ed38ad75b131bc0b67c.source: [ONE AGENT SAID HE COULD SUMMON A BALL OF PURE ENERGY]

O88da33ed71449216f356.source: [THAT HE COULD THROW LIKE A BOMB.]

O6cbba1545b2096187b1e.source: [HE SAID IT WAS SIMILAR TO OTHER ABILITIES IN THAT]

O12e53bdb002b5db41ff0.source: [HELLO? TOMCAT? I JUST PICKED UP ONE OF THOSE ORBS!]

Obe021cf4753ecbba2d96.source: [I - SSSSHK - CAN SEE THAT, AND - ZZZSHKT - DOING]

O005acff5336b76fdebd9.source: [IS - KSH - MAKING THIS CA- ZZZZKSHSHHH - OUT.]

Ofbe246d16d1496345d72.source: [W-WAIT! I THINK I CAN...! THERE... IT SHOULD BE]

O40fe9d218acd503e0ddc.source: [WELL, WHATEVER THAT ENERGY IS, YOUR P.A.W *HATES* IT.]

Ode54222a2e042280155c.source: [I WOULDN'T BE SURPRISED IF IT AFFECTED OTHER]

O236a72c8083e8abcf758.source: [HEY UHH TOMCAT, WHAT SORTA THINGS MIGHT HAPPEN IF I]

O57bf3c08a7506974962f.source: [WERE TO FIND MORE ORBS THAT DON'T SHOW UP ON YOUR END?]

Oe445ee69d72ef1830bf8.source: [HUH? WHAT'S WRONG PUP, YOU SOUND A LITTLE NERVOUS!]

O8298a3ee22e1aa41372d.source: [OH N-NO, JUST CURIOUS, THAT'S ALL! H-HAHA!]

Od5cb2273258f6c0c47b6.source: [WELL AS LONG AS YOU AREN'T GOING KOOKY ON ME, LITTLE BUDDY]

O40325139c4fbf15b1c1e.source: [OR I MIGHT HAVE TO SEND FOR THE PSYCH- IATRISTS AGAIN.]

Od49a80955607f3118a06.source: [THEY'RE ON CALL RIGHT NOW AFTER ALL THE AGENT REPORTS]

O9bf1bfe232349cff83d3.source: [THAT INVOLVED COMP- LETELY UNBELIEVABLE THINGS, YOU KNOW!]

O5faa6f82a0456f1a4d23.source: [WELL, YOU DIDN'T HEAR THIS FROM ME, BUUUUT...]

O2af9309d886b160e58dc.source: [THIS ONE CANINE FELLA JUST A BIT OLDER THAN YOU...]

Oc683b9f60f75be15042c.source: [...HE SWORE THAT HE COULD TURN FERAL!]

O211facfb3b8fe772cf97.source: [YEAH, SAID HE GOT IN TOUCH WITH A SIDE OF HIMSELF THAT]

Odec10fae5e431ef955da.source: [HE NEVER KNEW. RUNNIN' AROUND, DIGGIN' HOLES]

O37c6b171b41549f85512.source: [EVEN IF OTHER AGENTS STORIES TURN OUT TO BE TRUE]

O667e780bfbb5a1130f47.source: [THERE'S NO WAY HIS STORY WOULD BE REAL!]

Od89094245915c70fa6ec.source: [IT'S ALMOST A GOOD THING THAT HE WENT AWOL DOWN THERE]

O7bf0c8f12594935fd380.source: [SINCE WE HAD HIM SCHEDULED FOR INTENSIVE STUDY]

O36bacc6a1be8d69bcb24.source: [ON THE OFF CHANCE WHAT HE WAS TELLING THE TRUTH...]

O5c9b853d998d3afa1fc7.source: [WELL DON'T WORRY I HATE RUNNING AROUND AND DIGGING!!]

O69adf15a43b171b87373.source: [WOAH, I JUST SAW ANOTHER SPIKE IN YOUR VITALS!]

Oa4d55f2db4fc1c3ba6a7.source: [HEY, THE ORB WAS JUST FLOATING RIGHT THERE!]

Oe8c6b47f2f9e6739cfee.source: [IT SEEMS... THIS POWER MIGHT MAKE ME STRONGER? BUT...]

Oa3338743015970a98881.source: [WITH A TRADEOFF, LIKE GETTING HURT... HURTS MORE...?]

O08c34397c28c38a3fb01.source: [STARS HELP US, BUT I THINK YOU'RE THE EXPERT HERE.]

O7dff8dcce1fb7ef5706b.source: [IT SEEMS... THIS POWER MIGHT MAKE ME TOUGHER? BUT...]

Ofebffd735536dad5e505.source: [WITH A TRADEOFF, ATTACKING THREATS... HURTS THEM LESS?]

Oed8010f262fd3c4b56a0.source: [NOBODY EVER TOLD YA TO NOT PUT THINGS IN YOUR MOUTH, HUH?]

O0bb89ff8d46dce0b0c1c.source: [H-HEY! IT'S NOT THAT! IT WAS JUST, WELL...]

Oe85c830327e8c3baeef1.source: [PUP, YOU'RE GO'N BE LUCKY IF YOUR NETHER REGIONS DON'T]

O95f6a443ffe423cf8a66.source: [SWELL UP TO THE POINT WHERE YOU BE- COME A "TOP" AGENT.]

O7a69027b78c347c7dc79.source: [R-REALLY?? YOU MEAN I'LL FINALLY BE BIGGER THA-]

Obac7f8c626ad69cbbb65.source: [SHE'S JOKING YIFFAI THAT WAS JUST A PRE- MISSION PROTEIN PAK]

O9f284428053d4372e8b1.source: [THAT MUST'VE BEEN DROPPED BY OTHER AG- ENTS WHILE ESCAPING]

Ofcad1e21a3e520ac5e7d.source: [IT MIGHT GIVE YOU A BIT MORE VITALITY, IF ANYTHING.]

Oa288a614fc3326ac1927.source: [HAHA, SORRY TO LEAD YOU ON LIKE THAT, PUP!]

O86df5105019a9b066720.source: [AT YOUR AGE YOU'RE STUCK WITH BEING ADORABLY FUN-SIZED.]

Odec75a48721193eacce7.source: [W-WHAT GIVES? HEY TOMCAT I JUST PICKED UP A ROCK THAT...]

Of976a02d0fac733a3013.source: [...THAT SORT OF DISSOLVED WHEN YOU TOUCHED IT?]

Ob152e48072a5711c8ba9.source: [THAT WAS A PSY CRYSTAL, PUP. SUPPOSEDLY]

Oa4808a84b6af182585a8.source: [THEY WERE HIGHLY VALUED BY THE PLANET'S ESPERS.]

Od5253bbb394367d72cc6.source: [INHABITANTS OF THE PLANET CLAIMED THAT THEY WILL HEIGHTEN]

O707c10d4461152046e32.source: [BUT WE DON'T HAVE ANY WAY TO MEASURE IF THAT'S TRUE.]

O719321a2bb31b3e1783c.source: [YOU MEAN THAT ROCK COULD BE MAKING ME A STRONGER PSYCHIC?]

O861406e6fcf6089be58c.source: [...DON'T TRY EATING THEM? THEY AREN'T CANDY, I SWEAR.]

O60e11a24b669edca4f6c.source: [WOAH, WHAT IS THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP??]

O0616bbe35aacf4d41218.source: [I... I DON'T KNOW! SOME SORT OF COMPUTER CHIP?]

O673ef9e2b46c6b416735.source: [IT SEEMS TO REACT WHENEVER I PUT IT NEAR MY GEAR.]

O686391fb86c733581527.source: [DEFINITELY HOLD ON TO THAT. MAYBE YOU CAN FIND SOMEONE]

O2525fd37432127390787.source: [ON THAT PLANET THAT CAN TELL YOU WHAT IT'S FOR.]

O1bb1392ddd0081a65977.source: [WOOOAH THERE KIDDO, DO YOU KNOW WHAT YOU JUST PICKED UP?]

O0277ff5d9be0988bd1b9.source: [THAT IS SOME SUPER ILLEGAL STUFF IN YOUR PAW RIGHT NOW]

Of0c28dfb2c513f9935a6.source: [IT'S BLACK MARKET BIOCRYPTO, AND IT'S ALREADY TRYING]

Oa383d405e3d334ce719d.source: [TO INTERFACE WITH YOU ON A PHYSICAL LEVEL!]

Od2ff186ed6ad313724ef.source: [W-WHA? IT IS??? HOW DO I GET RID OF IT??!?]

O4f6f4ee1105e4bc01942.source: [HAHAHA, RELAX! THE EASY WAY TO GET RID OF IT IS TO USE IT]

O3dcb8cad8c09fe356ddf.source: [THOUGH WHO KNOWS WHAT KIND OF "USL" APP IT HAS ONBOARD.]

Oa7e69b9c9ee32fb6e51d.source: ["U-USL"?!? USE IT?!?! YOU JUST TOLD ME IT WAS ILLEGAL!]

O5235f0bf107f29edd815.source: [RELAX, AN AGENT ON A TOP SECRET OMEGA PROTOCOL MISSION]

O851616d1de09099dc3a7.source: [HAS JURISDICTION TO USE ANY MEANS AT THEIR DISPOSAL]

O156c510acc68674bbf0c.source: [EVEN IF IT'S OUTSIDE OF... NORMAL LEGALITY.]

Ofcc211714e6721f21c1a.source: [WOAH, REALLY? I HAVE THAT RIGHT NOW?]

Oedbb75277cb8cb2cefa3.source: [YUP, THAT'S RIGHT. IT'S JUST LIKE SQUEAKS SAID.]

O845c1ce698655ec9dc08.source: [I COULD GO OUT AND STEAL, OR PARK MY HOVERBIKE ANYWHERE]

O3be1ac2b1a8f8f484368.source: [TECHNICALLY, YES. BUT FOR NOW THE MAIN CONCERN IS SEEING]

Oaefa5d8f76dcad8db362.source: [WHAT THE UNIVERSAL SCRIPTING LANGUAGE APP ON THE COIN]

O7ddb8e647d6f60baa254.source: [DOES WHEN YOU USE IT WITH YOUR P.A.W.]

O98e06b061a921847829f.source: [OH! SO IT'LL RUN ON BASICALLY ANYTHING! I GET IT.]

O414477548154e49642c9.source: [SMART KID, JUST BE CAREFUL, NEVER KNOW WHAT BACKALLEY]

Of49538cab70d16661c26.source: [GAMES OR DISGUSTING NONSENSE COULD BE ON THOSE...]

O86e842b4d6c07a0a6baf.source: [YEAH! IF YOU END UP WITH SOMETHING REALLY IMMORAL...]

Oe9885a7e1e66fa9ea69d.source: [N-NO! I WAS JOKING!! IT WAS A JO-]

O27accfac95100145c8c5.source: [THAT'S A MAP DISK THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP THERE!]

O3a055acfd5d346f0e9f2.source: [OTHER AGENTS HAVE MAPPED OUT VARIOUS PARTS OF THE AREA]

Odf2965e3307b9fb510d5.source: [THAT YOU'RE CURR- ENTLY IN, SOMETIMES WITH NOTATION.]

O0bee27a58cc68d1c0d34.source: [JUST NAVIGATE OVER TO THE APPROPRIATE P.A.W. SUBMENU]

O6f9accb32678ad343858.source: [HEY, TOMCAT. I JUST PICKED UP SOME SORT OF WEIRD...]

O4319e5c36f1f9494ffd3.source: [NOT JUST ANY CARD, THAT'S A COSMOCARD, PUP!]

Ofae4812df3f2ab87ee2b.source: [IT WON'T HELP YOU OPEN ANY DOORS OR ANYTHING LIKE THAT]

O251bc937c19722f3c2f5.source: [BUT IT /WILL/ GIVE YOU SOME MORE INFO ON LOCAL FAUNA!]

Odbda5d65f9a01293653d.source: [SEE THOSE LITTLE DOTS ON THE SIDE? SLIDE THAT INTO THE]

O5858e0bfef4b0ec08b6f.source: [C-READER ON YOUR P.A.W. AND IT'LL GIVE YOU MORE INFO]

O633937b6b1c97d2e14af.source: [OOOOH I SEE! I CAN ACCESS THE DATA IN A P.A.W. SUB MENU!]

O2dc9f0c8a588df7d180b.source: [LOOKS LIKE THERE'S DATA ON ENEMEY POWER AND ITEM DROPS]

O9add654004ea4906e8ae.source: [AND ON THE CARD BACKS IT'S... IT'S...]

O541f42c80f4fbc6cf597.source: [TAKE YOUR TIME READING THE BACK OF THE CARDS, PUP]

Oe5a231cc4d9e633eee60.source: [WE ALL NEED A LITTLE BREAK NOW AND AGAIN!]

O53b1194f9b69db78d0a9.source: [SO, I JUST GOT THIS SHIP PART...]

Oc94e790ef3132906b95e.source: [I SAW! HEAVY EQUIPMENT ISN'T MY SPECIALTY, BUT]

O64b70bedbb47c034b02a.source: [WE'VE CONTRACTED A LOCAL MECHANIC AT THE OLD HANGAR WHO]
